title: Standup multi-project rollup + close-out dogfood
description:
## Product ask (Ryan / SD, 2026-09-10)

Gherkin-first, dual Python+Rust. SD owns Composer implementation (bc-f9b425e3); no duplicate worker.

### Scope
1. Multi-project rollup shapes: `--rollup project` (one bullet per project, upward-summarized) and `--rollup tree` (nested project→epic→leaf). Default: project at multi-project / congregation; tree OK inside single board.
2. Recursive upward right-now: parent/initiative/project rollup bullets recompute from children (LLM or structured reduce) — not flat leaf dump.
3. Project labels on every multi-project bullet.
4. Close-out section for kanban WIP control: ready-to-close / merged-but-still-in_progress / blocked-only-on-external-wait (replace or demote useless “Why is X still in progress?” Likely questions).
5. Deduplicate parent+child saying the same thing.
6. Empty Yesterday: explicit “no completions” (don’t leave blank).

### Constraints
- Specs first; dual-runtime
- No admin-merge
